title: Murder
overview: To escape a secure but stifling life with her workaholic husband Sudhir, bored housewife Simran begins an affair with Sunny, an ex-boyfriend from her college days. However, when Sudhir grows suspicious and hires a private detective, the infidelity soon comes to light.

songs.title: Murder (Audio Film)
songs.singers: Emraan Hashmi, Mallika Sherawat, Ashmit Patel
